title: Choose Avanti's homepage visual world
question: Choose the world that should carry Avanti's scroll story. The first direction is the assigned recommendation; alternates test different ways to make the work memorable.

options.label: The Property Plan
options.lineage: residential survey plats, landscape staking plans, and field-marking systems
options.thesis: One accountable crew reads the whole property, marks what matters, and carries it from routine care to finished improvement.
options.viewport: A full-bleed working-property photograph is crossed by a precise survey line that labels Care, Build, and Maintain while the headline and quote action sit on the open lawn.
options.risk: It becomes sterile if the technical linework outruns the warmth and evidence of the real crew.

options.label: Built in Steps
options.thesis: Every service is shown as a visible sequence from the property as found to the finished result.
options.case: Product clarity is excellent, but the toy-like grammar identifies less naturally with homeowners choosing a trusted property crew.
options.viewport: A three-step property transformation fills the viewport, with the current step in full color, prior work ghosted, and one clear arrow ending at Request a Quote.
options.risk: Without disciplined photography and adult typography, the system can feel playful rather than dependable.

options.label: The Project Lookbook
options.lineage: Japanese fashion mook spreads and annotated coordinate photography
options.thesis: Real project photographs overlap like a collected field lookbook, with ribbons naming the service and outcome in each scene.
options.case: The imagery feels authored and contemporary, but the fashion lineage identifies weakly with local property stewardship and makes service scanning less direct.
options.viewport: Three overlapping Avanti project photographs dominate the frame while one annotation ribbon connects the active image to the offer and quote action.
options.risk: The overlapping structure can obscure the strongest project proof on small screens.

options.label: Living Balance
options.lineage: tokonoma alcoves and asymmetric ikebana arrangements
options.thesis: A few carefully placed images, lines, and seasonal cues make the property feel composed rather than decorated.
options.case: The audience connection to landscaping is credible, but it fuses poorly with mowing, drainage, hardscaping, and the full-service promise.
options.viewport: One tall project photograph and two smaller proof moments form an asymmetric triangle around a quiet headline and grounded quote action.
options.risk: Its restraint can understate the practical breadth and energy of a working landscaping crew.

canonCard.label: The polished category standard
canonCard.thesis: A cinematic project hero, service overview, trust proof, gallery, service area, and quote close executed at a high level.
canonCard.viewport: A refined landscape video hero carries the offer, two equal contact actions, and a concise local proof line.
canonCard.risk: It is clear and credible but easier to confuse with another premium landscaping company.
